objective: Test whether the deployable error modes of the worst trained-CQ3 down projection are concentrated in a small set of x8-kernel-aligned output tiles, using the exact fixed-budget marginal-SSE optimum on training rows and an untouched interleaved confirmation split.

parent_finding.conclusion: The diagonal gauge optimizer did not improve its own hard-CQ3 training objective, and half-split payload retraining overfit confirmation. Reject diagonal gauges and target stable output-tile error modes directly.

scope.selection_reason: same worst v44 down-projection layer used by v71 and v72; no layer reselection

int4_quantizer.representation: signed INT4 values in [-8, 7] with one FP16 scale per 32 weights
int4_quantizer.scale_initialization: group maximum absolute value divided by 7, with an exact-zero group mapped to scale zero
int4_quantizer.iteration: round and clamp integer codes, then replace scale by dot(weight, code) divided by dot(code, code)
int4_quantizer.code_packing: two signed nibbles per byte, low coordinate first

tile_selection.candidate_inputs: v44 trained-CQ3 gate and up SwiGLU activations
tile_selection.marginal_benefit: training SSE of the v44 CQ3 tile minus training SSE of the signed-INT4 tile
tile_selection.optimization: choose the 80 largest marginal benefits; this is the exact uniform-cost fixed-cardinality optimum

canonical_layout.runtime_dispatch: one mode decision per x8 output tile; mutually exclusive CQ3 or INT4 computation, never an additive residual pass

decision.if_pass: replicate the unchanged 12.5-percent x8-tile rule on a preregistered representative layer set before any whole-model materialization
decision.if_fail: reject fixed-budget output-tile mixed precision at this rate and move to input-group correction or a higher-capacity structured transform without threshold tuning

claim_boundary: Frozen train-confirmation layer-59 representation pilot only. A pass cannot establish whole-model capability, perplexity, CUTE, MATH, code, MMLU, throughput, energy, novelty, 100 tokens per second, or a scientific breakthrough.
